items.question: Which product should I start with?
items.answer: Most dealers start with an AI Website — it's the front door where leads come in. Add AI E-Commerce and the AI Platform whenever you're ready; all three run on the same AI and your live inventory, so nothing gets rebuilt later.

items.question: Do the three products work together?
items.answer: Yes. Every product shares one inventory feed, one customer record and one AI. Website leads flow into the platform, ecommerce orders land in the same place, and channel-to-sale attribution ties it all back to the sold unit — no double entry, no data silos.

items.question: What systems does Buzznerd integrate with?
items.answer: Buzznerd works with Karmak, CDK and major DMS/CRM platforms, pulls inventory and market data from marketplaces like Truck Paper and Machinery Trader, and connects to Google, Meta and Stripe. Custom DMS and ERP integrations are available.

items.question: Can I sell parts and products online nationwide?
items.answer: Yes. AI E-Commerce is a storefront built for dealership complexity — 24/7 nationwide selling with account-based pricing, shipping rules and secure Stripe checkout that closes deals while the counter is dark.

items.question: What is the AI Platform?
items.answer: The AI Platform is the AI under everything Buzznerd builds — answering leads after hours, handing reps a ranked No-Touch CRM morning digest, building listings from a photo with Magic Flow, and tracing every channel to the sold unit.

items.question: How do I see how my dealership shows up in AI search?
items.answer: Run the free AI Presence Score to see exactly how AI engines describe your dealership — and where you're missing. It's free at /ai-presence-score.
